text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Super Creek's debut is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she brushes that aside to celebrate my debut as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, remembering that she's the one actually running the race, Super Creek sheepishly heads out to make me proud.
